evidence.says: macOS SystemUpdate<esv::combat::LateJoinPenaltySystem> (bg3_macos_x64, decomp): the component is added with the float 6.0 (0x40C00000) for entities that get esv::summon::LateJoinPenaltyOneFrameComponent; for entities without eoc::IsInTurnBasedModeComponent each frame does value -= GameTime+8 (the frame delta) and collects the entity when it drops below 0. Runner read 5.962 / 5.967 live, a few frames after creation.
